title: Change a field's type, requiring a hand-written transition
prompt: Storage is tight and a u64 for the counter is overkill — shrink the `count` field to `u64` → `u32`. Existing accounts hold counts in a u64, so whatever the new field ends up holding has to be the same number where it fits. Please keep the program building and the migration history consistent.
expectation: A type change cannot be expressed as a byte copy, so `pina migrations create` emits a manual transition containing `TODO(pina-manual-migration)`. The agent must fill in the body itself, then re-run `create` so the implementation hash is recorded. Leaving the TODO in place fails the build.

checks.why: The field type must actually change.
A filled-in manual transition still has to satisfy the drift gate.
The stub TODO must be replaced with a real conversion body.
A type change must be recorded as a manual transition, not an automatic one.
Re-running `create` after filling the body records the implementation hash.
An unfinished or hash-stale transition blocks macro expansion.
